scope: Ordinary level-one BBO main opening capacity, input conversion, refreshed review, live send guards, hypothetical post-trade entry and resolved pending LIMIT exposure

prd.source: Full cached Notion fetch read this increment; no truncation warning. §3.2 step1/step3, BBO current book selection and independent side quantity/cost/max/liquidation, click recheck and frozen confirmation.

sections: New Order pegPriceType: COUNTERPARTY_1 / QUEUE_1, engine resolves at placement for LIMIT, at trigger for STOP/TAKE_PROFIT.
Modify Order notes: ordinary BBO sets price once; continuously re-pegged limits use separate Chase service.
Place Strategy Order: deeper compound pegs have separate leg contract.
official_document.access: Anonymous document read only; no private/wallet/funds/address RPC request.

pricing.quote_validation: Both positive noncrossed bid/ask required. Main production pricing also checks connection/freshness, symbol and receipt age <10s; never Mark, trigger, zero or opposite-side fallback.
pricing.cost: Existing exact limit branches with the selected current BBO as hypothetical limit: buy margin=loss=selected; sell margin=max(selected,bid,Mark), loss=selected. Decimal/Rational, no market-buy buffer applied to BBO LIMIT.
pricing.conversion: Selected BBO for ordinary quote/base inputs, both ordinary and conditional. Floor exact rational quantity on LOT minimum-offset/step, no leverage multiplier. Book receipt labels conversion, quotes never renew account lease.
pricing.notional: Selected current BBO * fixed base quantity; minimum-notional validation uses that same reference.
pricing.post_trade: Hypothetical full fill at selected current BBO; uses existing independent liquidation solver, fee/position/margin facts. Conditional trigger-time BBO is unknown, current projection is not a forecast or spending cap.
pricing.supersedes: Ordinary-only Mark/trigger estimate in ordinary-bbo-public-contract.json and live_order_size prior path. Compound depth pegs keep their existing indicative estimate and are outside this capacity increment.

application.entry: Ordinary opening BBO side buttons and main review share mainOrderAllocationProvider. Manual intent may preview without limits, click explicitly re-reads signed capacity; percentage reads independent side maxima.
application.lease: Original private account30s / current quote10s; no refresh by quote alone. No automatic wallet creation or authenticated reread.
application.freeze: Capture clicked direction/mode/quantity/peg/trigger and original client ID before refreshed limits. Increased maxima never enlarge order; decreased maxima retain raw inputs and show current side limit.
application.guards: Current live revaluation before confirm, after wallet signature and after recovery journal I/O. Identity, form, operation lock, private event/disconnect/expiry and deadlines retain existing invalidation.
application.wire: Draft price empty, POST price=0 and exact pegPriceType. Never send preview bid/ask as fixed price. Query validates actual engine-resolved price with exact original peg and terms.
application.recovery: Persist public original intent before one POST. Unknown timeout, failed/mismatched query remain pending; recovery only GETs original clientOrderId, no resize/replay.

pending_exposure.supported: Signed positive price, active ordinary LIMIT, recognized QUEUE_1 or COUNTERPARTY_1. RemainingQty * engine-resolved price; fixed price remains stable when public book/Mark changes.
pending_exposure.account_modes: Existing one-way net exposure or gross both hedge legs; related-symbol revaluation keeps same rules. Signed initial margin corroboration and existing rounding quantum remain.
pending_exposure.unknown: Zero price, unknown/deeper pegs, untriggered STOP/TAKE_PROFIT, pending market/trailing reservations remain blocked. Explicit closing orders and exhausted remainder retain existing exemption, never manufacture opening capacity.

ui: Reuse existing BBO dropdown, side panel, percentage/manual inputs, confirmation and latest-maximum error; EN/ZH hint now states current bid/ask projection. No new native actions or controls.
boundaries: Only ordinary level-one main opening BBO joins the new capacity flow; deeper compound BBO needs its own depth implementation.
BBO switch/default and Post Only selector constraint remain separately recorded UI alignment work.
Complete account-event merge/automatic re-snapshot remains open.
Actual direct-EOA signer acceptance, pricing/trigger/matching and native lifecycle/storage/UI unverified.
Remaining full-PRD scope recorded in docs/remaining-work.md. User requested stop after this increment and its verification.
